findings: Pose-specific fixed actor-center alpha gaps explain real wasted shots; no before/after-AI native-alpha/query mismatch observed.
Surveyor route aim wastes15 Pistol rounds or20 rivets in the starting12m live fixture; visible opaque fallback needs7 Pistol shots or4 rivets with all contacts.
Reaver route aim misses its pain pose for2 Rivet shots; visible opaque fallback reduces5 accepted shots to3.
Always aiming a triangle centroid can worsen Shotgun spread coverage: Unsealed one-shell kill becomes two. Conditional fallback preserves an already valid center ray.
Recommend correcting automated route aim to current visible anatomy before declaring campaign ammo insufficient; retain existing HP, damage, pain interruption and alpha-shaped hitboxes.

limitations: Ranged foes naturally stand and attack at12m, so supplementary25m runs observe genuine ranged walking; ranges are recorded per sample/shot.
Chest comparator chooses current production geometry, not a broadened hitbox; no collision/pose/stat edits.
One deterministic spread seed sequence per live run; counts are evidence for this fixture, not stochastic accuracy estimates.
scope: Source executable physics at60Hz: player frozen, enemy AI/Combat/projectiles active, stable original enemy HP/damage/native art. Route ordering mirrored (aim/fire at physics_frame before AI); query-only probes additionally run after AI with late physics priority. Actual held Pistol/Shotgun/Rivet compare global_position+.28, nearest opaque chest triangle, and conditional visible chest fallback. Not a normal player movement/strafe/campaign route or exported release acceptance.
